InstantClone

PPPlayer

PPPlayer is a free, open-source, cross-platform music and video player built with Flutter. It brings local media, YouTube playback, internet radio, and network streams together in one modern, easy-to-use application. Designed for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS, PPPlayer supports multiple audio and video formats, playlists, playback queues, background playback, and customizable media controls. Its goal is to provide a powerful, lightweight, and completely free alternative to traditional media players, with no subscriptions and a community-driven development approach.

ChatGPT Image is a browser-based creative workspace with text-to-video and image-to-video generation alongside AI image creation and reference-photo editing. streamtop - Terminal Live HLS/DASH/IPTV Stream Diagnostics

A zero payload terminal diagnostic tool for live HLS, DASH, and IPTV streams built in Rust. Instead of downloading full multi megabyte media chunks, it uses targeted HTTP Range requests (~2-64 KB) to inspect fMP4 and MPEG-TS container headers, verify cross-segment GOP cadence, extract wire-level audio metadata, and monitor CDN edge cache hit/miss behavior in real time.

name.value: PPPlayer is a free, open-source, cross-platform music and video player built with Flutter. It brings local media, YouTube playback, internet radio, and network streams together in one modern, easy-to-use application. Designed for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS, PPPlayer supports multiple audio and video formats, playlists, playback queues, background playback, and customizable media controls. Its goal is to provide a powerful, lightweight, and completely free alternative to traditional media players, with no subscriptions and a community-driven development approach.
